caseNameFull: MILLER BREWING CO. v. JONES, DIRECTOR OF REVENUE OF ILLINOIS
attorneys: Frank H. Uriell and Paul A. Teschner for appellant., William O. Clark, Attorney General of Illinois, and Richard A. Michael and John J. O’Toole, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
